title: Urgent: Friday San Jose workshop — client asks to move to Monday
text:
Urgent: Friday San Jose workshop — client asks to move to Monday

["From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>, events@grandsky.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: San Jose — final prep + travel notes for Friday workshop

Hi Oliver / GrandSky team,

Quick confirmation for Friday (8/24) in San Jose: Redwood team will arrive Thursday evening. Attached is the current itinerary and the workshop agenda — we plan to run 9:00–4:00 with a light lunch and a 30-min customer Q&A slot at 3pm.

Logistics checklist:
- Room: GrandSky, Pacific A (set for U-shape, projector + breakout mics)
- AV: HDMI + backup adapter, house laptop access
- Parking: validation codes for guest speakers (we'll need 3)

Oliver, can you confirm the onsite sponsor will still be available for the 3pm Q&A? If anything changes, flag it here and we'll rework the agenda. Laura / Dev — please review the attached itinerary and call out any travel adjustments needed.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood_itinerary_sjc_v1.pdf, workshop_agenda_v1.docx", "From: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: events@grandsky.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: San Jose — final prep + travel notes for Friday workshop

Sean — thanks for the prep. Unfortunately I need to ask for a hard move. An equipment failure at our main data center triggered an emergency all-hands and our exec sponsor (Maya Rao) has been pulled into the response. We won't have the key stakeholders available Friday afternoon.

Would you be able to move the session to Monday 8/26 instead? Same start time. I realize this is short notice — we appreciate Redwood being flexible.

I'm copying the hotel so they can hold Monday as a standby. I can confirm sponsor availability by end of day Sunday.

Apologies for the disruption — Oliver Park
Program Manager, HarborTech Financial
opark@harbortech.com | (650) 555-0133", "From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>, events@grandsky.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: San Jose — final prep + travel notes for Friday workshop

Laura / Dev — forwarding Oliver's note. Two asks:
1) Laura — can you liaise with GrandSky and move room + catering to Monday 8/26 (same 9:00–16:00 window)? If there are any rate differences or cancellation fees, flag to me immediately — I'll escalate for credits.
2) Dev — we booked two speakers' flights arriving Thursday night. Can you check change fees and see whether we can rebook them for Sunday evening instead (cheaper than cancelling and re-buying). Also verify that the hotel will hold rooms for the team.

If GrandSky requires a deposit or there are penalties, I can sign off on up to a $1,000 change — beyond that I need approval. I'll follow up with OLiver once we get confirmation from the hotel.

Sean

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 12:40 PM Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com> wrote:
> Sean — thanks for the prep. Unfortunately I need to ask for a hard move. An equipment failure at our main data center triggered an emergency all-hands and our exec sponsor (Maya Rao) has been pulled into the response. We won't have the key stakeholders available Friday afternoon.
> 
> Would you be able to move the session to Monday 8/26 instead? Same start time. I realize this is short notice — we appreciate Redwood being flexible.
> 
> I'm copying the hotel so they can hold Monday as a standby. I can confirm sponsor availability by end of day Sunday.
> 
> Apologies for the disruption — Oliver Park
> Program Manager, HarborTech Financial", "From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: events@grandsky.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: San Jose — final prep + travel notes for Friday workshop

Hi all — GrandSky can move the booking to Monday 8/26 and will waive the room change fee if we confirm by 10am PT Sunday (they put Monday on hold). Catering requires a headcount update by Friday morning; they can accommodate our original menu.

Costs: no room fee, catering same price, small AV tech overtime (estimated $150) because the tech shift will be different. If that works, Sean, I'll update the booking and send amended invoice. I've attached the updated agenda (minor tweaks to accommodate attendee availability).

Dev — flights: Delta flights for Priya and Marcus currently show a $120 change fee each to move to Sunday evening and no fare difference. Let me know and I'll authorize the change.

Oliver — please confirm Monday for the sponsor and if you want us to keep the original 9:00 start. Once you confirm, we'll finalize hotel and travel.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0144

Attachments: updated_agenda_sjc_v2.docx, venue_contact_grandsky.vcf

-----Original Message-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Sent: Saturday, August 22, 2026 2:05 PM
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>; events@grandsky.com
Subject: Fwd: Re: San Jose — final prep + travel notes for Friday workshop", "From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <opark@harbortech.com>, events@grandsky.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Workshop moved to Monday 8/26 (updated itinerary attached)

Oliver / GrandSky / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Laura the hotel has waived the room change fee and AV overtime is estimated at $150. We've authorized the two flight change fees for our speakers (Dev confirmed).

Plan summary:
- New date: Monday, 26 Aug 2026, 09:00–16:00 (Pacific A, GrandSky)
- Lunch: boxed lunch + coffee break at 11:30
- Attendees: HarborTech exec sponsor confirmed (Maya Rao)
- Attachments: redwood_itinerary_sjc_v2.pdf (final travel), updated_agenda_sjc_v2.docx, venue_contact_grandsky.vcf

Oliver — can you confirm final attendee list by Friday morning so catering has accurate counts? We'll send final travel confirmation to speakers once you confirm.

Appreciate the flexibility — see you Monday.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199"]
